## Part 2: Data Ethics

**Scenario:** This planting-date and cover-crop trial design is based on a real study of winter rye at three locations. Now imagine you are a graduate student running this same kind of analysis for a similar planting-date trial. While checking your ANOVA assumptions, you notice that one block at the northern location has biomass and nitrogen values far outside the range of every other block. The values are far outside of the bological range expected, your advisor tells you to drop that block from the analysis since "it's obviously a mistake." 

Consider this scenario as you answer the following questions.
